blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Thin ashfall is expected to affect nearby towns following the minor volcanic explosion at Taal Volcano’s main crater on Thursday evening, Oct. 8, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) said. In an advisory, Phivolcs said that it observed a minor phreatomagmatic eruption occurred at the main crater of Taal Volcano around 6:06 p.m., which lasted five minutes. READ: Taal Volcano triggers minor phreatomagmatic eruption – Phivolcs A phreatomagmatic eruption transpires when rising magma interacts explosively with water.
